name: tubealfred-youtube
description: Fetch YouTube video, channel, transcript, comments, replies, search, and playlist data from inside Claude Desktop. Uses the TubeAlfred API.
long_description:
TubeAlfred exposes 17 read-only YouTube research tools through one hosted MCP server: youtube_video_get, youtube_video_transcript, youtube_comments_list, youtube_comments_page, youtube_replies_list, youtube_replies_page, youtube_channel_get, youtube_channel_about, youtube_channel_videos, youtube_channel_shorts, youtube_channel_playlists, youtube_channel_community, youtube_search_query, youtube_search_suggest, youtube_search_hashtag, youtube_playlist_get, and youtube_url_resolve. Install this extension, paste your API key, and the tools appear in Claude Desktop's tool list.

Credits: 1 per call for most endpoints. Comment endpoints meter per item: 1 credit per 5 comments, 100-comment minimum per call.

tubealfred_api_key.title: TubeAlfred API key
tubealfred_api_key.description: Create one at https://tubealfred.com/app/api-keys. Live keys start with ta_live_, test keys with ta_test_.
